author: marici.Strominger

checks.statement: among nonnegative even pole depths only a=0 reaches rows 0 or 1
at even onset cutoff only a=g+8 reaches rows 0 or 1
the a=0 endpoint obeys the cocircuit identity
checks.detail: R0=-2*g*RisingFactorial(4, g) - 7*RisingFactorial(4, g); R1=-3*g*RisingFactorial(4, g) - 7*RisingFactorial(4, g)

checks.statement: the a=g+8 endpoint obeys the cocircuit identity

checks.detail: all other columns have R0=R1=0 by the support gates

checks.statement: a one-unit coefficient shift leaves a symbolic residual

verdict: For every even g>=2 at q=2g+8 and k=g/2+4, support intervals show that only the minus endpoint (a,m)=(0,-3g-7) and plus endpoint (g+8,1) can reach target rows 0,1. Direct symbolic path coefficients give R1/R0=(3g+7)/(2g+7) on both endpoints; all other columns vanish on both rows. Hence (2g+7)R1-(3g+7)R0=0 columnwise for arbitrary even grade.
